newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Guoco Holdings rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Guoco Holdings rated buy.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Securities said on Wednesday it has recommended a buy on Guoco Holdings (Philippines) Inc, a unit of Hong Kong's Guoco Group Ltd.
In an advisory to clients, analyst Annabelle Arceo said the company is expected to post hefty profits from its real estate investments.

She cited the Centennial City project in Manila Bay where gross profit margin is expected to reach 52 percent, with reclamation and development costs estimated at around 6,000 pesos per square meter versus a pre-selling price of 12,500 pesos.
Guoco's earnings per share is estimated to rise by 21 percent to 75 centavos for the fiscal year ending June 1997 against an estimate of 62 centavos this year, she said.
Guoco closed at 6.40 pesos on Wednesday, 3.2 percent up from the previous 6.20 pesos.
